posts.text: Celebrating 250 years of America. 🇺🇸 This is about our shared story. We've accomplished incredible things, we've made mistakes, and there's still work to do. posts.text: Spent the day canvassing in New Jersey's 7th Congressional District with Swing Left and volunteers from their Ground Truth program. We knocked on doors, listened, and took the time to hear what people are actually worried about. You can do the same thing from anywhere in the country! Head to the link in bio. #groundtruthpartner
